definitions.explanation: The management of financial records, bookkeeping, and accounting within an organization.
The department or staff responsible for financial management in a company.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {経|けい} (manage, govern) + {理|り} (reason, manage). Literally "managing/governing matters."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{経理|けいり}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧/{経理|けいり}⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (accounting department)
・{経理|けいり}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧/{経理|けいり}⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧ (accounting staff)
・{経理|けいり}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧ (accounting operations)
・{経理|けいり}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧ (accounting software)
・{経理|けいり}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (accounting procedures)

CONTRAST:
・{経理|けいり}: practical accounting work in companies

・⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧: finance/financial affairs (strategic level)
